def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # fix island label variants (extra spaces)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # parse body_mass_g written as text (handles commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # fix out-of-range body mass: values like 3625000 appear to be grams*1000
    mask = (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500) & (df['body_mass_g'] / 1000 >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] / 1000 <= 6500)
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    # keep sex missing as NaN (unknown); do not guess
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d[d['sex'].notna()]
    means = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in means.items()}
